{{Otheruses|Planetary Defense Force}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a '''planetary defense force''' was stationed at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Torize]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. During the Moff's retreat from [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Sarne supplemented his [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] with [[Starship/Legends|ships]] drawn from the complement at Torize.
